posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Just saying "puzzle game" and "puzzle gameplay" doesn't mean anything.
Have you done tutorials on MV, and practiced making just regular games? What you're asking about would be done using event commands, so the more familiar you are with them, the more you'll be able to accomplish on your own.
And if you do need help, please read
the section rules.
Ask specific questions. Provide screenshots.

posts.author: ISC
posts.body:
Since you're just starting, you could create a choice-based system. So, a question with 4 answers to choose from. Each correct answer allows you to increase your score. Ok, it's more of a quiz game than a puzzle game, but this simple experiment could be useful for learning how to use a lot of things such as:
- Text message box
- Multiple choices
- Variables
- Conditional branches
